messages:
anna_marketing: hey team — marketing needs a compact "method note" + reproducible artifacts to support a launch claim about ~2x cost reduction with batching+4-bit quant. target publish: Thu morning. can runtime run a small validated sweep?

josh_growth: is this for the launch blog or a paid placement? will affect how conservative we need to be.

anna_marketing: both. blog + a one-line stat we'll use in press outreach. prefer conservative wording but need numbers we can show.

paula_runtime: ok. propose a 3-cohort smoke: short (<=40 toks), medium (~150), long (~400). measure: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens-per-second cost normalized to fp16 baseline. we'll do fp16 baseline and 4-bit quant.

rana_eng: add runtime notes: run 2 warmup phases (50 short requests, 20 medium), then 5 measured repeats for each concurrency level (1,4,8). export per-request CSV and a short runbook.

anna_marketing: can you also capture coldstart numbers (first-request latency) and a tiny heatmap of tail across conc settings? legal wants caveats.

paula_runtime: yep. we'll include a coldstart timeline gif for comms. bench-bot: job queued as run/1791234567-smoke. started 1791234580. estimated runtime ~90m.

josh_growth: what payloads should we use for 'medium' and 'long'? need real-ish product copy not toy sentences.

rana_eng: suggested prompts: product explainers + short customer support snippets. keep seed=2026 for reproducibility. sample: {"input": "Explain Redwood Inference in 2 sentences for a product blog.", "max_tokens": 100, "temperature": 0.0, "seed": 2026} (use same rng across runs).

paula_runtime: config: repeats=5, conc=1,4,8, metrics: request_id, cohort, seq_len, latency_ms, tokens_generated, model_variant, quant_mode. we'll report mean+std and include raw CSVs.

bench-bot: smoke run completed. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1791234567/initial_smoke.tar.gz (csvs + traces + logs).

paula_runtime: preliminary numbers attached. note: 4-bit quant runs used default kernels (no extra tuning), so treat them as "initial quant". tuned fp16 runs done. quant tuning ETA ~2h.

anna_marketing: good callout. marketing will label quant as "initial" if tuning not finished. legal-bot: please include these caveats in the method note: model id, exact batch sizes, hardware used, and that numbers vary by workload.

legal-bot: acknowledged. recommend explicit line: "Results are from internal benchmarks on N GPUs under controlled input distributions; individual results may vary."

josh_growth: timeline: if tuned quant numbers come back today, we'll use tuned numbers in the blog. otherwise, publish with fp16 vs initial-quant with caveats.

paula_runtime: uploading final artifacts and a short 3-bullet method blurb now: 1) cohorts and counts, 2) warmup procedure, 3) cost model (token-level cost = GPU time prorated + infra overhead). link: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1791234567/final_artifacts/

anna_marketing: perfect — i'll draft the press sentence and ping legal. thank you! :raised_hands:
